svg.title: SEP crypto AXI isolation
svg.desc: AXI isolation inside sep_crypto. The host AXI4 port from the SEP local crossbar enters u_axi_demux in u_sep_crypto_axi_interconnect, which has thirteen manager ports. The OTBN, AES, HMAC and KMAC ports are converted to 32-bit AXI4-Lite and pass through u_otbn_host_isolate, u_aes_host_isolate, u_hmac_host_isolate and u_kmac_host_isolate into the engine wrappers; the Adams Bridge port stays 64-bit AXI4 and passes through u_abr_host_isolate into the Adams Bridge wrapper, which exists only when SEP_ABR_EN is defined. The entropy source port is converted to 32-bit AXI4-Lite and the CSRNG and EDN ports to 64-bit AXI4-Lite; they pass through u_esrc_host_isolate, u_csrng_host_isolate and u_edn_host_isolate into u_sep_trng. The Key Manager crossbar u_xbar drives its private AXI4-Lite key bus through u_otbn_key_isolate, u_aes_key_isolate, u_hmac_key_isolate, u_kmac_key_isolate and u_abr_key_isolate into the key CSRs of each engine wrapper, and its eFuse bus through u_km_efuse_isolate into u_sep_efuse_wrapper. The eFuse and lifecycle ports leave the demux as AXI4 without isolation, the eFuse leg through u_efuse_shim_axi_mux; the Key Manager mailbox port and the external TRNG port are converted to 32-bit AXI4-Lite without isolation, the external TRNG leg through u_trng_axil_cut to ext_trng_axil_req_o; the thirteenth port is the DECERR slave u_axi_err_slv. Each isolate stage names the sequencer in u_sep_reset_ctrl that requests it: a host isolate belongs to its engine's sequencer, a key isolate to its engine's sequencer or the Key Manager sequencer, and the eFuse isolate to the Key Manager sequencer. The sequencers exchange isolate requests and acknowledges with the interconnect and drive the seven gated resets. A coloured bar on each instance marks its reset: rst_ni for the interconnect, the isolate stages, the eFuse wrapper and the lifecycle controller; one gated_rst_ni bit for each engine wrapper, the TRNG and the Key Manager crossbar; and both sep_reset_ni and the Key Manager warm reset for the mailbox.
svg.text: sequencers u_<name>_isolate_seq for otbn, aes, hmac, kmac, abr, trng and km
